name: namecheap
description: Manage Namecheap domains, DNS, availability checks, and account balance from Cursor / Grok Bot.

NAMECHEAP_API_USER.title: API user
NAMECHEAP_API_USER.description: Namecheap API username. This is your Namecheap account username.

NAMECHEAP_API_KEY.title: API key
NAMECHEAP_API_KEY.description: Namecheap API key from Profile → Tools → API Access. Set it here only. Do not paste it into chat.

NAMECHEAP_CLIENT_IP.title: Client IP
NAMECHEAP_CLIENT_IP.description: Public IPv4 address whitelisted in Namecheap API Access. Namecheap accepts IPv4 only. This must be the egress address that calls the API.

NAMECHEAP_USERNAME.title: Username
NAMECHEAP_USERNAME.description: Optional UserName for API calls. Leave blank to use the API user.
